title: Review Roadbike JAVA SILURO 6 TOP TERBARU | NEW First Impression

takeaways.text: The Siluro 6 Top uses an aluminium aero frame with UCI marking and a carbon-look smoothed finish, a carbon fork, 40 mm alloy wheels, 28 mm Kenda tires and 160 mm hydraulic discs.
For 2025 the rear and front derailleurs changed from SENSAH to Shimano 105 with an 11–32 cassette and 34/50 crank; some cable is still visible at the cockpit.
Quoted at about Rp 11.2 million with a free helmet; the shop gives the weight as about 10.6 kg without pedals.

disclosure: An Indonesian shop presenting a bike it sells; the Indonesian 2025 build mixes Shimano 105 derailleurs with L-TWOO shifters and may differ from the candidate's full R7120 listing.
summary: An Indonesian shop's first look at the 2025 JAVA Siluro 6 Top, an alloy aero road bike; Indonesian automatic captions.
